483-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.

1496-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1496-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.

654-1308-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-1308-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-1308-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
